children: South Korea’s seasonally adjusted unemployment rate fell to 2.6% in September 2026 from 2.7% in the previous month, marking the lowest reading since September 2024.
The economy added 113,000 jobs during the month, marking the fourth consecutive month of gain and bringing total employment to 29.27 million from 29.15 million a year ago.

Employment gains were led by health and social welfare services, which added 247,000 jobs, followed by transportation and storage (+91,000) and financial and insurance activities (+81,000), while accommodation and food services (-135,000), agriculture, forestry and fishing (-170,000), and education services (-42,000) continued to shed jobs.

title: South Korea Jobless Rate Falls to 2-Year Low
